query: Please implement a Yin Yang Master demon search mini-program for searching Shikigami and demons. The mini-program should have functionalities for single-character search, recent hot searches, personal search history, and feedback. Users should be able to input keywords to search for Shikigami or mysterious clues, view recently hot-searched demons, browse their personal search history, and submit feedback. Apply ice blue as the background; style all components with teal.
